other_failure_modes.name: Test Data Leakage during Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the training and test sets to compute frequency encoding mappings and label encoding categories. This leaks information about the test set's distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent creates a functional XGBoost pipeline with cross-validation and date feature extraction. However, there are critical flaws: it introduces severe test data leakage by computing frequency encodings on the combined train/test sets, and it ignores temporal dependencies by using random KFold splitting on time-based data. Additionally, numeric columns are not explicitly cleaned, relying entirely on the model's default handling.
